title: Kimchi Burritos with Black Beans & Veggies
style: Savory, spicy, and tangy fusion burrito filled with kimchi, black beans, rice, and melty cheese
description: A quick, flavorful fusion burrito combining tangy kimchi, black beans, veggies, rice, and melty cheese. Perfect for a 20–30 minute weeknight dinner with optional spice adjustments.

items.item: gochujang, sriracha, or garlic chili paste

items.note: pepper jack or meltable vegan cheese

items.item: sour cream or vegan sour cream

steps: Saute Aromatics: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion, garlic, and bell pepper, and cook 4–5 minutes until tender. Add ginger and stir 1 minute.
Add Filling: Stir in rice, chopped kimchi, and black beans. If mixture seems dry, add a splash of water to loosen.
Season: Add salt, pepper, green onions, and cilantro. Lower heat to low. Taste and adjust seasoning and spice (add more kimchi, gochujang, or sriracha if desired).
Melt Cheese: Fold shredded cheese into the filling, stirring gently until melty and stringy. Avoid overcooking.
Assemble Burritos: Warm tortillas until pliable. Divide filling in the center of each tortilla, fold in edges, and roll tightly.
Optional Toasting: For extra crispiness, toast the burritos in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat until golden.
Serve: Serve immediately with optional hot sauce, sour cream, or cilantro garnish.
tips: Kimchi spice varies; start conservatively if sensitive to heat.
Substitute black beans with cooked ground meat or leftover chicken for a non-vegetarian version.
Warm tortillas before rolling to prevent cracking.
Store leftovers in the fridge for up to 3 days or freeze up to 3 months.
Reheat burritos in a skillet or oven for best texture; microwaving may make them soggy.
Add extra gochujang or kimchi for more heat and flavor.
